President and Governor extend Prakash Parv wishes

President Droupadi Murmu and Governor extended greetings on the eve of Prakash Parv, also known as Kartik Purnima. The President urged citizens to embrace the teachings of Guru Nanak Dev and spread messages of love and equality. The Governor highlighted Guru Nanak Dev as a source of inspiration for humanity.
